name: Caorunn Gin
description: Invigorating, clean and crisp, aromatic with a long dry finish.

name: Schweppes Slimline Tonic Water
description:
Masterfully made with quinine since 1783. A timeless classic, Perfect mixed with Gordon's®.

With Sweetener

Serve cold for maximum refreshment.

Store in a cool and dry place

Please recycle.

name: Bombay Sapphire London Dry Gin 1L
flavour_style: balanced, bright, fresh and citrus-forward taste
description: In its iconic blue bottle, Bombay Sapphire London Dry Gin features 10 hand selected botanicals from around the world, creating a balanced, bright, fresh and citrus-forward taste. Perfect for classic gin cocktails like a Gin & Tonic or Sapphire Negroni.

name: Fever-Tree Light Mediterranean Tonic
description: If 3/4 of your drink is the mixer, mix with the best.

name: Fever-Tree Refreshingly Light Indian Tonic Water
description: By blending luscious botanical oils with spring water and quinine of the highest quality from the 'fever trees' from the eastern hill ranges of the Democratic Republic of Congo, we have created a delicious, award-winning tonic water.

name: Fever-Tree Premium Indian Tonic Water
description: Our Premium Indian Tonic water uses a handful of different botanicals, including our distinctive quinine and oils from Mexican Bitter Oranges, to give a uniquely clean and refreshing taste and aroma.

name: Gordon's Alcohol Free Spirit with Distilled Botanicals 0% vol
description: Gordon's 0.0% Alcohol Free Spirit provides the bold, piney juniper-led taste you'd expect from Gordon's, but without the alcohol. It delivers a truly authentic and vibrant non-alcoholic experience that captures the spirit of the range perfectly. Recommended for your mocktails and as the perfect alcohol-free alternative to your usual gin and tonic.

name: Hendrick's Gin (Abv 41.4%)   70cl
flavour_style: smooth with subtle flavours rose petal and cucumber essence
description:
- No other Gin tastes like Hendrick’s because no other Gin is made like Hendrick’s. Smooth, with a balance of subtle flavours, Hendrick's Gin is a deliciously refreshing infusion of rose petal and cucumber essence.
- Perfectly delectable whether neat or mixed, Hendrick’s Original Gin, with its signature cucumber garnish, is a refreshingly exquisite addition to any summer garden party or BBQ that will have your guests coming back for more.
- Elevate any Gin cocktail and special summer night with Hendrick’s Gin – opt for a refreshingly curious Hendrick’s Cucumber Lemonade or release your inner mixologist and shake up a Hendrick’s Martini, or sip a delightful Hendrick’s Negroni.
- Hendrick’s Gin is an exquisite gift for any drinker and any occasion, the bold vintage design elevates the at-home entertaining experience for any Gin lover, cocktail expert, or at-home bartenders alike.
- For a taste of summer in every sip, concoct the classic Hendrick’s and Tonic – a simple, yet elegant, drink perfect for any summer gathering. Simply serve Hendrick's over ice with tonic water and garnish with thinly sliced cucumber.

Experience the unique infusion of rose and cucumber with Hendrick’s Gin. This balance of distinctive yet subtle flavours adds a remarkable twist to the quintessential gin and tonic. Why settle for ordinary when you can have deliciously unusual?

Crafting gin cocktails
The floral fragrance and smooth taste of Hendrick’s Gin makes it ideal for cocktails that can be as classic or creative as the occasion demands. Raise the bar of elegance with original gin cocktails at drinks parties and garden get-togethers. Or serve in a refreshing gin and tonics to accompany low-key nights in.

Perfectly presentable for gifting
Wondrously versatile, Hendrick’s Gin is as cracking at Christmas as it is sublime in summer. Dressed up in a striking black bottle with an apothecary-inspired look, this premium spirit transforms a drinks cabinet from purely practical to delightfully decorative – the perfect gin gift.

How the gin is made
No other gin tastes like Hendrick’s because no other gin is made like Hendrick’s. Handcrafted in Scotland by award-winning distillers William Grant & Sons, the excellent quality and unusual taste of Hendrick’s Gin is fiercely protected.
- Hendrick’s is a divine marriage of two different spirits from two utterly dissimilar types of stills: the Bennet Still and our rare Carter-head Still.
- Combining these two spirits with marvellous infusion of rose and cucumber yields an extraordinarily smooth gin that is a rare union of lightness and complexity. Award

In 2018, the Hendrick's Master Distiller, Lesley Gracie was named Distiller of the Year 2018 by Gin Magazine

Produced by family owned distillers, William Grant & Sons, named Distiller of the Year at the International Wine & Spirits Competition 2018 and the International Spirits Challenge 2018.

name: Gordon's Premium Pink Spirit Drink
description: Gordon's Premium Pink is a vibrant gin crafted with the perfect balance of natural botanicals and distilled fruit essences. Infused with the flavour of raspberries, strawberries and redcurrants, this gin boasts a pink hue and a refreshing fruity flavour profile. Gordon's Premium Pink provides a light and refreshing tasting drink that makes the perfect gift for gin lovers or simply to enjoy with friends. The spirit balances the crisp, juniper taste of Gordon's with the sweetness of raspberries and strawberries and a tang of redcurrant. Inspired by an original 1880 recipe from Alexander Gordon, Premium Pink is carefully crafted using the highest quality ingredients.

name: Whitley Neill Rhubarb & Ginger Gin
description: Inspired by the glory of the English country garden. Essence of rhubarb adds a tart crisp edge whilst the real ginger warms the palate.

name: Fever-Tree Light Aromatic Tonic
description: By blending the gentle bitterness of South American angostura bark with aromatic botanicals, such as cardamom, pimento berry and ginger, we've created a delicious, unique tonic water that can be enjoyed with gin to make a Pink G&T or as a sophisticated soft drink on its own.

name: Tanqueray London Dry Gin 70CL
description: Tanqueray London Dry is a perfectly balanced gin, delivering the ideal combination of four classic gin botanicals: refreshing juniper, peppery coriander, aromatic angelica and sweet liquorice. Created by Charles Tanqueray in 1830, Tanqueray London Dry Gin is still made according to the original timeless recipe. This award-winning and iconic spirit, distilled four times, is best enjoyed with a premium tonic water of your choice, plenty of ice and a wedge of lime, although it also makes a great base for a variety of cocktails.

name: Whitley Neill Blood Orange Gin
description: Inspired by the vibrant flavours of Sicily. Extract of sanguine Sicilian blood oranges injects a dynamic citrus burst to the clean gin base.

name: Whitley Neill Handcrafted Dry Raspberry Gin
description: Bright flavours from Scottish raspberries, balanced with juniper notes. A delicate sweetness rounds this deliciously vibrant gin.

name: Whitley Neill Distillers Cut London Dry Gin   70cl
description: Strong Juniper and citrus fruits, hints of orange, angelica root, liquorice and coriander to form a complex Dry Gin.

name: Whitley Neill Black Cherry Gin
description:
Black Cherry Gin
Inspired by South African cherry orchards, this delicious gin is infused with succulent black cherries for a deep and luscious flavour.
Johnny Neill

name: Brecon Botanicals Gin   70cl
description:
The nose is a rich complex of fresh juniper. Followed quickly with coriander and a complexity of gin flavours. Hints of citrus mingle with oriental spices. On adding a mixer the citrus, lemon, orange and even bergamot open out as well as hints of cinnamon, clove and even saffron.

Medium length on the finish leaving you ready for the next mouthful.

Distilled from pure grain. Combined with Botanicals from the four corners of the world. Blended with water from the beacons to create a clear spirit that is crisp, clean and exceptionally smooth.

name: Gordon's Lemon Meringue 35% Vol 70cl
description:
An iconic British twist on the original recipe from Alexander Gordon.

The classic taste of Gordon’s, perfectly balanced with zesty lemons and a delicate meringue sweetness. Made using only natural flavourings and colourings.

name: Whitley Neill Gin Japanese Yuzu & White Strawberry 70CL
description: Infused with zesty, fragrant citrus notes of Japanese Yuzu and succulent White Strawberries to create an exotic, bold gin.

name: Sipsmith London Dry Gin (Abv 41.6%)   70cl
description:
At Sipsmith we believe in uncompromisingly handcrafting our gin, and in celebration of becoming the first ever official gin partner of our equally uncompromising neighbour Wimbledon - home of The Championships, we've crafted a limited edition bottle* for our London Dry Gin for tennis and gin fans to cherish. Raise a toast to exquisite summer sipping!

*Please note, receiving the Sipsmith London Dry Gin 70cl bottle with the limited edition Wimbledon label is not guaranteed, you may instead receive the original bottle.

Sipsmith London Dry Gin is fresh, clean, and beautifully balanced with a sweet botanical bouquet complete with Juniper, baked lemon tarts, and white pepper.
Every drop is lovingly hand-crafted at London’s first copper-pot distillery for almost 200 years. We launched the craft gin boom in London – or, as we like to call it, the ginaissance – that has seen hundreds of small-batch gin distillers following in our intrepid footsteps.
Smooth enough for a Martini, yet rich and balanced, perfect for a G&T, Sipsmith London Dry Gin is a joy from first to last sip.

name: Ableforth's Bathtub Gin
description: Award-winning craft gin, double infused for extra flavour. Hand-crafted from start to finish: first we distilan already delicious London dry gin in a traditional copper-pot still, then we take our extra step. We cold infuse With juniper, coriander, cassia, cardamom, cloves and the very finest orange peel over a further seven days, tasting regularly to ensure that distinct Bathtub flavour we're proud of.

name: Engine Organic Italian Gin 500ml
description:
Engine is an Organic Italian gin produced in Piedmont, in Northern Italy. Engine Organic Gin is made using 100% Italian botanicals and has a stout structure but a kind soul. It sparkles on the rocks and shines in tonic water. Our aluminum cans are made out of recycled olive oil and motor oil cans. Further recycling of Engine Gin cans uses up to 90% less energy than recycling glass.

GT is the liquid acronym for Gin Tonic

Ingredients:
50ml of Engine Gin
100ml Tonic Water

Method: Pour all the ingredients directly into the ice-filled glass. The tonic water must be very cold! Garnish with a sage leaf.

42% Alc/Vol

name: Monkey 47 Schwarzwald Dry Gin
description: A curious gin from Monkey 47, produced in Germany's Schwarzwald – also known as the Black Forest – and made with an impressive combination of no less than 47 botanicals. This medley of ingredients includes fruits and herbs that are native to the Black Forest, as well as exotic Asian botanicals, including elderberries, mint, almonds, jasmine, ginger, Vervain and camomile, to name a few. Understandably complex, the palate finds a delicate balance between notes of juniper, citrus, sweet flowers, bitter fruit and peppery spices that lends itself well to use in cocktails such as Martinis and Gimlets, as well as being mixed with tonic and garnished with a slice of orange.

name: Tanqueray London Dry Gin (41.3%)
description: A true classic, Tanqueray dry gin has been made with the same timeless recipe since 1830. With a solid juniper character, this textbook gin is a great all-rounder that works well in a Gin & Tonic and Martinis.

name: Hendrick's Gin
description: A superb, and utterly unique, pink-tinged gin from William Grant's. Infused with rose petals and cucumber as well as the normal botanicals, this is a must for all gin-lovers.  In the summertime, Hendrick's makes a fantastically refreshing gin and tonic: serve in a tall glass with plenty of ice and garnish with thinly-sliced cucumber – delicious!

name: Xoriguer Gin Mahon
description: A cult gin from Mahon in Menorca, Xoriguer is one of the only gins in the world (alongside Plymouth) to have a geographical indication, Gin de Menorca. Gin has been made on Menorca since the 18th century British occupation and Xoriguer commands a devoted following of happy travellers. Unusually, Xoriguer is made in wood-fired pot stills from distilled wine (eau-de-vie) rather than the more usual grain-based distillate, and is rested in oak barrels before bottling.

name: Plymouth Gin
description: An elegant redesign of Plymouth, matching up their much respected and geographically protected gin with an old-school chunky bottle and their traditional branding. A must have for any home cocktail bar or lovers of a gin and tonic.

name: The Botanist Islay Dry Gin
description: An exciting and unusual gin from Islay whisky distillery Bruichladdich, The Botanist is made in a Lomond still christened Ugly Betty and contains no fewer than 31 botanicals, of which 22 are native to the Southern Hebridean island itself. The latter include the likes of mugwort, meadowsweet and the enigmatic Lady's Bedstraw flowers, and the resultant dry gin is described, perhaps unsurprisingly,  as 'floral'.

name: Papa Salt Coastal Gin
flavour_style: balanced gin with subtle mineral edge
description: Made in Byron Bay, this gin combines native botanicals including wattleseed, pink peppercorn, and oyster shell with hibiscus, citrus peel, and wax flower. The result is a balanced gin with a subtle mineral edge.

name: Roku Noryo Tea Edition Gin
description: A limited-edition Japanese gin inspired by the noryo tradition of summer cooling, showcasing sencha and gyokuro green tea alongside Roku’s signature botanicals. Fresh and quietly complex, it layers grassy tea, soft citrus and delicate florals over a smooth, subtly umami palate, finishing clean with a gentle spice and cooling lift.

name: Ki No Bi Kyoto Dry Gin
description: Produced at Japan's Kyoto Distillery, Ki No Bi is the first gin to be made in the city. Made with a rice spirit and botanicals including yellow yuzu, Japanese cypress, green tea, bamboo and sanso berries (Japanese peppercorn), this has classic juniper notes which complement the Japanese botanicals. With a warming and spicy finish, this will make a delicious G&T.

name: Isle of Harris Gin
description: An aromatic Scottish gin from the Isle of Harris, part of the larger island of Lewis And Harris in the Outer Hebrides, and is made with a combination of nine botanicals, including hand-picked sugar kelp from local sea-lochs. The palate offers notes of juniper berries, bitter orange peel, coriander seed and liquorice root, as well as sweet-and-salty sugar kelp.

name: Monkey 47 Schwarzwald Dry Gin Gift Box
description: A curiously aromatic gin from Germany, Monkey 47 is made with a whopping 47 botanicals. These botanicals create a complex palate that lends itself well to simple, classic cocktails such as a Martini.

name: Capreolus Garden Swift Dry Gin Half Litre
description: Capreolus Garden Swift Dry Gin (formerly known as Garden Tiger) is made in Gloucestershire using an impressive 34 botanicals, of which most are secret. Two that are revealed are fresh Sicilian blood orange zest and lime-tree flowers. This incredibly complex gin can be enjoyed on its own, or in cocktails.

name: Oyster Fine de Claire Adriatic Gin
description: A premium Adriatic gin with classic juniper at its core, complemented by herbal and maritime botanicals for an elegant, balanced, and aromatic taste.

name: Fords London Dry Gin
description: Fords Gin is made at Thames Distillers in London using wheat. The botanicals – including Spanish lemon peel, Turkish grapefruit peel and Chinese jasmine – are steeped in the stills for 15 hours before distillation. The result is a gin where the botanicals come to the fore.

name: Hendrick's Orbium Gin
description: The distillers who brought us Hendrick’s beloved cucumber and rose gin have hit on another great innovation: quininated gin. By infusing their spirit with quinine and wormwood, Hendrick’s have created an complex and intriguing drink that pays homage to what is often mixed with gin: tonic and vermouth. The quinine and wormwood flavours are rounded out by blue lotus blossom, which adds bright floral notes to the mix.  Although it's delicious in tonic, you might also like to try Orbium with soda - which really lets the gin's flavour shine through - or in a classic cocktail such as a Martinez or Martini.

name: Personalised The Quintessential London Dry Gin
Sincere Pure Gin
description: Sincere Pure is an sugar-cane-based organic gin from Paraguay. Made using botanicals including angelica root, star anise, orris root, cloves, cinnamon, pink peppercorns, lemongrass and the indigenous congorosa, this is a rich and full-bodied spirit. All the ingredients are locally harvested, and the gin is sold in bottles made from 96% recycled glass.

name: Withers G1 Gin
description: The first gin released by Withers Gin, G1 is made with a combination of eight botanicals, including juniper, pink grapefruit zest and heartsease flower. Zesty, peppery and floral, try using this gin to create a refreshing G&T, garnish with a sprig of rosemary.

name: Tanqueray No.Ten Gin Litre
description: A super-premium small-batch Tanqueray named after the number of the No. 10 still in which it is made.  A superb controlled explosion of very aromatic botanical flavours, and it looks very good on your mantelpiece / drinks cabinet.

name: Edinburgh Gin The Classic
flavour_style: pine buds, lavender, lemongrass, mulberries and orange peel
description: This is a small-batch gin from Scotland that shows notes of pine buds, lavender, lemongrass, mulberries and orange peel. Try a measure of this in a Gin Fizz or a Gimlet.

name: Bude Cornish Dry Gin
description: The Cornish Distilling Company’s first foray into gin has been given a coastal Cornish twist. The region is known for its picturesque coast and boasts a vast array of aquatic plants that make great botanicals. This gin is made with a blend of nine botanicals including juniper, kelp, bladderwrack seaweed and grains of paradise which offer a saline minerality to your gin and tonics.

name: Gin Mare Capri Mediterranean Gin
description: In celebration of its 10th anniversary, Gin Mare has released a super-premium gin inspired by the iconic Italian island Capri. Made with a blend of botanicals including juniper, arbequina olive, basil, thyme and both lemon and bergamot from the Sorrento peninsula, Capri is aromatic and herbal with a lively vein of citrus throughout the palate.

name: Juniper Green Organic Gin
flavour_style: light and elegant, gentle burst of spice
description: A London Dry Gin certified organic by the Soil Association, Juniper is something of a first.  The palate is light and elegant, with a gentle burst of spice at the finish.

name: Gin Del Professore Monsieur
flavour_style: richer classic notes of juniper and citrus
description: The Del Professore range is a collaboration between Federico Ricatto, Carlos Quaglia and the Jerry Thomas Speakeasy in Rome. The Monsieur gin is the richer of the range, with classic notes of juniper and citrus.
